name: Planter box
blurb: A flower or herb planter for a porch or window sill, with holes so the water drains.

steps.text: Cut two sides, two ends and the bottom from the 1x6.
Drill three half-inch drain holes in the bottom.
Screw the sides to the ends to make a frame.
Fit the bottom inside and screw through the sides into it.
Sand the top edges. Use cedar, or a finish made for outdoors, so it lasts.
